mapper.select: SELECT TEMPLATE_ID, TEMPLATE_NM, DESCRIPTION FROM SURVEY_TEMPLATE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TEMPLATE_NM, TEMPLATE_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY WHERE TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SURVEY_TEMPLATE (TEMPLATE_ID, TEMPLATE_NM, DESCRIPTION, USE_YN, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{templateNm}, #{description}, #{useYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE SURVEY_TEMPLATE SET TEMPLATE_NM = #{templateNm}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT S.SURVEY_ID, S.TITLE, S.DESCRIPTION, S.START_DE, S.END_DE, S.ANONYMOUS_YN, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SURVEY_PARTICIPATION P WHERE P.SURVEY_ID = S.SURVEY_ID AND P.USER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PARTICIPATED_YN FROM SURVEY S WHERE S.STATUS = 'OPEN' AND S.START_DE <= #{today} AND S.END_DE >= #{today} ORDER BY S.END_DE, S.SURVEY_ID LIMIT 200

SELECT S.SURVEY_ID, S.TEMPLATE_ID, T.TEMPLATE_NM, S.TITLE, S.DESCRIPTION, S.START_DE, S.END_DE, S.STATUS, S.ANONYMOUS_YN, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_QUESTION Q WHERE Q.SURVEY_ID = S.SURVEY_ID) AS QUESTION_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_PARTICIPATION P WHERE P.SURVEY_ID = S.SURVEY_ID) AS PARTICIPATION_CNT, S.REGIST_DT, S.UPDT_DT FROM SURVEY S LEFT JOIN SURVEY_TEMPLATE T ON T.TEMPLATE_ID = S.TEMPLATE_ID WHERE S.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SURVEY SET TEMPLATE_ID = NULLIF(CAST(#{templateId} AS VARCHAR(30)), ''), TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, START_DE = #{startDe}, END_DE = #{endDe}, ANONYMOUS_YN = #{anonymousYn}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SURVEY WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.update: UPDATE SURVEY SET STATUS = 'OPEN', UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE SURVEY SET STATUS = 'CLOSED', UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND STATUS = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT QUESTION_ID, SURVEY_ID, QUESTION_NO, QUESTION_TXT, QUESTION_TYPE, REQUIRED_YN, ORDR, REGIST_DT, UPDT_DT FROM SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} ORDER BY ORDR, QUESTION_ID

SELECT Q.QUESTION_ID, Q.SURVEY_ID, Q.QUESTION_NO, Q.QUESTION_TXT, Q.QUESTION_TYPE, Q.REQUIRED_YN, Q.ORDR, S.TITLE AS SURVEY_TITLE, S.STATUS AS SURVEY_STATUS, Q.REGIST_DT, Q.UPDT_DT FROM SURVEY_QUESTION Q JOIN SURVEY S ON S.SURVEY_ID = Q.SURVEY_ID WHERE Q.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ORDR), 0) + 1 FROM SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SURVEY_QUESTION SET QUESTION_TXT = #{questionTxt}, QUESTION_TYPE = #{questionType}, REQUIRED_YN = #{requiredYn}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_ID, QUESTION_ID, ITEM_TXT, ORDR FROM SURVEY_ITEM WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} ORDER BY ORDR, ITEM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SURVEY_ITEM (ITEM_ID, QUESTION_ID, ITEM_TXT, ORDR, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{questionId}, #{itemTxt}, #{ordr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_PARTICIPATION WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SURVEY_PARTICIPATION (PARTICIPATION_ID, SURVEY_ID, USER_ID, SUBMIT_DT) VALUES (#{participationId}, #{surveyId}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO SURVEY_ANSWER (ANSWER_ID, PARTICIPATION_ID, QUESTION_ID, ITEM_ID, ANSWER_TXT, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{answerId}, #{participationId}, #{questionId}, #{itemId}, #{answerTxt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT Q.QUESTION_ID, Q.QUESTION_NO, Q.QUESTION_TXT, Q.QUESTION_TYPE, I.ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_TXT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_ANSWER A JOIN SURVEY_PARTICIPATION P ON P.PARTICIPATION_ID = A.PARTICIPATION_ID WHERE P.SURVEY_ID = Q.SURVEY_ID AND A.QUESTION_ID = Q.QUESTION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID) AS ANSWER_CNT FROM SURVEY_QUESTION Q JOIN SURVEY_ITEM I ON I.QUESTION_ID = Q.QUESTION_ID WHERE Q.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} ORDER BY Q.ORDR, I.ORDR

SELECT Q.QUESTION_NO, Q.QUESTION_TXT, A.ANSWER_TXT FROM SURVEY_ANSWER A JOIN SURVEY_QUESTION Q ON Q.QUESTION_ID = A.QUESTION_ID WHERE Q.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND Q.QUESTION_TYPE = 'TEXT' ORDER BY Q.ORDR, A.REGIST_DT, A.ANSWER_ID LIMIT 200
